Accomplishment
1. Assisted the US government in the Persian Gulf War code-named "Desert Storm" and helped the US military victory, because of pre-analysis and cracking of crisis data, 1991

2. Has led numerous international major disaster investigations, including the Three Mile Island nuclear disaster in the United States, the explosion of the Space Shuttle Challenger, and the accident at the Chernobi nuclear power plant in Russia (曾主導過無數的國際重大災難調查，包括美國三哩島核能災變、太空梭挑戰者號爆炸、俄國車諾比核能電廠事故等)
